Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. - 5+ years building anti-fraud, anti-abuse, or risk systems at consumer scale (payments, marketplaces, fintech, or large social platforms).

TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company. Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.

Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.

The Product Owner’s primary responsibility is product planning and execution of our initiatives in alignment with the product management team. This role works closely with engineering, sales, and marketing to meet revenue and customer satisfaction goals. 

Role and Responsibilities

• Partner closely with Product Management to execute on vision, strategy and roadmap

• Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities are clearly defined and stakeholder needs are accurately represented

• Translate user needs into clear, actionable JIRA tickets

• Define user stories and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and aligned to business objectives

• Collaborate with internal teams on a routine basis to identify product needs and prioritizations

• Support Engineering efforts in release planning, backlog refinement, execution and delivery timelines

• Participate in testing and validation of new features to ensure functionality meets quality requirements

• Partner with QA to ensure acceptance criteria accurately support test creation

• Monitor feature adoption and gather feedback to inform improvements and refinements 

• Serve as primary liaison, facilitating requirement discussions between Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders

• Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, operational processes, and healthcare business needs

• Advocate for end-user experience throughout development lifecycles

• Escalate issues and recommendations to the Product Management as needed

• Collaborate with Finance and other teams as needed to support business cases and ROI analysis

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field

• Experience in project management or product lifestyle including ownership of backlog, prioritization, requirements and releases required

• Experience with presenting to upper management

• Entrepreneurial spirit, self-starter

• Able to break down complex technical problems and processes

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams

Preferred Skills

• Demonstrate anintellectual curiosity to explore why and when behind clinical decisions

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong leadership skills

• Ability to handle complex situations

• Experience working in Microsoft Teams and JIRA strongly preferred

• Experience working with healthcare technology preferred

• Background with product demonstrations strongly preferred

Mental and Physical Demands

• This position will be exposed mainly to an indoor/office environment and will be expected to work in or around computers and printers.

• The nature of the work is sedentary, and the employee will be sitting most of the time.

• Essential physical functions of the job include typing and the repetitive motion to utilize computer software and hardware continuously throughout the day.

• Essential mental functions of this position include concentrating on analytical tasks, reading information, and verbal/written communication to others continuously throughout the day.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title : Cloud Engineer
Role Purpose
Design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure aligned with enterprise banking standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure environments across public and hybrid cloud platforms

• Implement and enforce cloud security, governance, and compliance controls in line with enterprise and regulatory standards

• Monitor, optimize, and continuously improve cloud performance, availability, and cost efficiency

• Collaborate with application, security, and DevOps teams to support cloud-based solutions and migrations

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices

• Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis to ensure system stability

• Maintain documentation for cloud architectures, configurations, and operational procedures

Required Experience & Skills

• Minimum 5 years experience in infrastructure, cloud engineering, or platform engineering roles

• Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Strong understanding of cloud networking, compute, storage, and identity management concepts

• Experience implementing security controls within cloud environments, preferably in financial services

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate in enterprise, regulated environments

• Experience supporting high-availability and mission-critical systems

Nice to Have

• Experience within banking or financial services environments

• Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates

• Familiarity with cost management, monitoring, and optimization tools

• Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications)
